name: Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024
description: Divorce rates (divorces and annulments per 1,000 residents, by state of occurrence) and marriage rates for every state that reports them to the CDC's National Center for Health Statistics, for 1990, 1995 and each year 2000 to 2024, with each reporting state's latest rate, its 2019 rate and its rate in 2000 (or its first reported year after 2000) and the change since; and the national provisional counts of divorces and marriages each year since 2000, with the states the national divorce count leaves out. Rates and counts only, as NCHS publishes them.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845898

distribution.name: marriage-divorce.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: marriage-divorce.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: marriage-divorce
recordSet.description: The records of Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code (50 states and DC), or US

field.name: level
field.description: us or state

field.name: kind
field.description: divorce (divorces and annulments) or marriage

field.name: stateName
field.description: State name (United States on the national records)

field.name: year
field.description: The latest year of the NCHS table (states without a rate that year have no record of that kind)

field.name: status
field.description: P: the NCHS figure as published

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: The rate in that year (the same as rate)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: rate
field.description: Per 1,000 residents in the latest year

field.name: rate_2019
field.description: Per 1,000 residents in 2019

field.name: base_year
field.description: The first year from 2000 on with a published rate (2000 for most states)

field.name: rate_base
field.description: Per 1,000 residents in base_year

field.name: change_since_base
field.description: rate minus rate_base

field.name: years_published
field.description: How many years have a published rate (1990, 1995 and 2000 onward for states; 2000 onward for the US)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
